description: Rename an AppLovin campaign or change its budget, goal value, countries, US states or metros, end date or landing page, read back. On a LIVE campaign a budget, goal, country or end-date change needs confirm:true. Status is set_applovin_ads_status; goal type, bidding and start date cannot change. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

audienceStrategy.description: audience strategy: UNIVERSAL, PROSPECTING or DISCOVERY

confirm.description: required for a spend change on a LIVE campaign

countries.description: ISO country codes the campaign runs in

countryBudgets.description: per-country daily budgets keyed by ISO code, e.g. {US: 50}

countryGoals.description: per-country goal values keyed by ISO code

dailyBudget.description: new daily budget in account currency, all countries

goalValue.description: new target cost, or ROAS ratio (0.9 = 90%)

usMetros.description: US metro names such as NEW_YORK; not together with usRegions

usRegions.description: US state codes; only when US is a target country

websiteUrl.description: landing page URL for a WEB campaign

name: update_applovin_ads_campaign
title: Update an AppLovin Ads campaign
